verdict.rationale: Fin documents its own escalation controls: a help article on managing escalation guidance and rules, a 'Giving Fin Guidance' article, and direct transfer to human agents in the inbox. That points to configurable hand-off to humans. However, the evidence is only article titles and taglines, so topic-level human-only marking and a guarantee that Fin won't answer those topics are not shown. missing for 10: documented topic-based escalation rules (e.g. legal, cancellation, security), evidence of deterministic enforcement so Fin never answers marked topics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I mark topics as human-only — legal threats, cancellations, security — and the agent never freelances on them

citations.quote: Manage Fin AI Agent's escalation guidance and rules
Transfers to agents directly in preferred Inbox
